investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-12T01:13:18Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api layer could not reach the swarm backend ELB at /v1/agents during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs before any agent is created, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, and all contract assertions are unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the internal load balancer (ELB in us-east-2) that backs POST /api/agents → /v1/agents — was unreachable from the production-api runtime at the time of the eval run. This is an infrastructure-layer failure upstream of the eval runner: the runner's createAgent call (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs line 1885) never received a successful response, so the probe terminated with a 502 and produced an empty evidence object. The failure is localized to the swarm gateway dependency shared by all three remote-agents checks; it is an eval-observed infrastructure signal, not a confirmed user-traffic outage.

possibleCauses: Primary: The swarm ELB in us-east-2 was down, misconfigured, or had no healthy targets at the time of the eval run, causing the production-api to receive a 502 when forwarding POST /api/agents to /v1/agents.
Secondary: A network routing or security-group change between the production-api and the swarm ELB blocked connectivity, producing a connection error that the API layer surfaced as 502 bad_gateway.
Tertiary: The swarm service itself (behind the ELB) was restarting, deploying, or had crashed, leaving the ELB with zero healthy backends and returning 502 to all inbound requests.

Lower probability: A transient DNS resolution failure for the ELB hostname caused the request to fail before a TCP connection was established; the error message 'error sending request for url' is consistent with a pre-connection failure.
